text: A subsequent validation-selected normal/NMRI specialist increased mean NMRI test recall from 0.54% to 16.82%, while normal false alarms rose from 1.90% to 2.60%. Accuracy was 95.46%, macro-F1 0.8854, and overall attack detection 92.23%. This improves the observed trade-off, but most NMRI attacks are still missed. The same training-fitted specialist was shared across three hybrid seeds; these are not three independent specialist fits or independent-dataset replicates.
